description: This PHP source file defines the class 'actionCreateRecord', which extends 'actionBase'. It contains methods for rendering HTML UI components for creating records via workflows, executing the creation action, setting record fields, managing relationships, and copying email addresses in the context of SuiteCRM. The class facilitates dynamic form generation, record creation, relationship management, and email validation within the SuiteCRM/AOW_Actions module.

classes.name: actionCreateRecord
classes.description: Represents an action that creates a new record within SuiteCRM, providing UI rendering, execution, attribute setting, relationship management, and email validation functionalities.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript files required for the UI component.

methods.name: edit_display
methods.description: Generates HTML for editing/creating records with options for record type, relationships, and related fields.

methods.name: run_action
methods.description: Executes the creation of a new record, including setting fields, relationships, and optional email copying.

methods.name: set_record
methods.description: Populates the new record's fields based on parameters, with support for various data types and calculations.

methods.name: set_relationships
methods.description: Establishes relationships between the new record and other beans based on parameters.

methods.name: copyEmailAddresses
methods.description: Copies email addresses from one bean to another, with validation.

methods.name: validateCurrentEmailAddress
methods.description: Validates that an email address array contains all required indices and logs warnings if not.
